# /clone: every dimension form x strict x mask mode x move mode, one case that works and one that fails.
# Flat world, creative; Bot = op. Source blocks: stone with a chest and an air hole; the nether is forceloaded at 0 0.

gamerule random_tick_speed 0
gamerule spawn_mobs false
execute in minecraft:the_nether run forceload add 0 0 31 31
execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 0 0 31 31
